{{Quote|I'm not about to follow a gang of father's hired goons anywhere.|Korlana Toryn, to the Heroes of Cularin, after the agents were dispatched at Jasso Toryn's behest to transport her to the planet Almas|<ref name="Contract AA23" />)}}
'''Jasso Toryn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the governing body of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Toryn feared for the safety of his daughter, [[Korlana Toryn|Korlana]], and he sent her into hiding on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He later wrote to his friend [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] in about [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] and asked that Korlana be placed under the direct protection of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], and Qel-Bertuk agreed to Toryn's request.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It is far too dangerous. Oh dear. If only the Senator had not sent us here.|E-3PO, on Nar Shaddaa, after Jasso Toryn sent his daughter Korlana and the droid to the moon|<ref name="Contract AA23" />}}
Jasso Toryn was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a child, Toryn was good friends with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Human [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], and, after Qel'Bertuk was accepted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the pair remained closely acquainted. Toryn went on to become a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]<ref name="Contract AA23" />&mdash;the governing body of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;which operated from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> At some point he [[Reproduction/Legends|fathered]] a child, [[Korlana Toryn]], on whom he doted, and he gave her a privileged upbringing.<ref name="Contract AA23" />

By [[Time/Legends|time]] of the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Toryn had became a long-serving and respected member of the Senate who was well-known as a staunch supporter of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. However, he gained some influential enemies among the Separatists, and, fearing for his daughter's safety, he sent Korlana and his [[valet droid]], [[E-3PO (Clone Wars)|E-3PO]], to go into hiding on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], far from the influence of both the Republic and the Confederacy. The war continued to develop,<ref name="Contract AA23" /> and, in about [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', [[Contract AA23 (roleplaying adventure)|''Contract AA23'']] can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Toryn heard rumors of Separatist supporters gathering on Coruscant, in the heart of the Republic. Concerned that Korlana might not be safe from the Separatists even on Nar Shaddaa, Toryn wrote to Qel-Bertuk and requested that Korlana be placed under the direct protection of the Jedi on [[Almas]], a world in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] on which Qel-Bertuk served as the [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]] of a [[Almas Academy|Jedi academy]]. Qel-Bertuk agreed to the Senator's request, and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] dispatched the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a renowned team of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], to retrieve Korlana from Nar Shaddaa and transport her to Almas.<ref name="Contract AA23" />

{{RPG|[[Contract AA23 (roleplaying adventure)|''Contract AA23'']]}}
The agents successfully located Korlana and brought her to the [[Jedi academy|academy]], and Toryn asked Qel-Bertuk to thank them on his behalf. The Senator also offered to aid the agents in the future, by using his influence to reduce bureaucratic [[Paper/Legends|paperwork]] for the operatives if they ever needed to have official dealings with the Republic.<ref name="Contract AA23" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You have once again done me a great service and for that I thank you. As does Senator Toryn. He wished me to express to you his appreciation. Rest assured that it will take tangible form.|Lanius Qel-Bertuk, to the Heroes of Cularin, after they successfully escorted Korlana Toryn to the planet Almas|<ref name="Contract AA23" />}}
As a child, Toryn wanted to be a Jedi, and he later became regarded as a strong supporter of the Order within the Senate. He also cared deeply for his daughter, Korlana, and he spoiled and mollycoddled her, which led her to develop a very naive outlook on life. Following the eruption of the Clone Wars, Toryn became concerned for Korlana's safety, so he sent her into hiding on Nar Shaddaa, but he continued to worry about her well-being and was very grateful when the Heroes of Cularin escorted her to the Jedi on Almas.<ref name="Contract AA23" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jasso Toryn was mentioned in [[Contract AA23 (roleplaying adventure)|''Contract AA23'']], a [[2004]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Russell Foubert]] and [[Sean Yo]] that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the adventure the player characters [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the Heroes of Cularin, and, if they successfully retrieve Korlana Toryn from Nar Shadaaa, they are each awarded a "Gratitude of Senator Jasso Toryn" certificate, which can be redeemed for various in-game roleplaying benefits.<ref name="Contract AA23" />
